title: observability: token-level + KV cache metrics, dashboards, and alert tuning
author: Ava Chen
description: Add token-level and KV cache observability surface: Prometheus metrics, tracing spans, structured logs, Grafana dashboards, and alert tuning. Motivation: provide engineers and SREs with actionable signal for per-token cost/latency regressions and cache effectiveness to reduce unit cost and improve tail-latency debugging. This PR implements: 1) New Prometheus metrics: redwood_inference_tokens_processed_total (labels: model, route, customer_tier), redwood_token_latency_seconds (histogram with token_position, model), redwood_kv_cache_hits_total / redwood_kv_cache_misses_total (labels: model, shard, hit_type), redwood_kv_cache_hit_latency_seconds. 2) Tracing: add token-level span annotations for large requests (sampled) and KV cache span with hit/miss tag; add baggage for request_route and model_version. 3) Structured logs: enrich existing request logs with token_count, kv_cache_hit_ratio, and estimated_token_cost_usd. 4) Dashboards: Grafana dashboards (Token Cost & Latency, KV Cache Heatmap, Per-Route Cost Breakdown) with panels, alert panels and example queries. 5) Alert tuning: tuned SLO-aware alerts to reduce noise (percentile-based alerts for p50/p95 token latency, KV cache hit ratio alerts with burn-rate policies, per-customer cost anomaly alert). 6) Docs + runbook: short runbook entry describing triage steps for token regressions and KV desync cases. Checklist: - [x] metrics and metric names agreed in metrics RFC - [x] prometheus exporter instrumentation - [x] basic dashboards and panels - [x] alert definitions in alerting repo - [x] unit tests for metric labels and histogram boundaries - [x] e2e smoke tests for logging enrichment - [x] docs and runbook. Notes: kept new metrics optional behind feature flag (observability.token_kv_enabled) to allow staged rollout; added compatibility shim for older exporters to avoid missing-metric noise. Related: ENG-4821 (token cost observability), ENG-4890 (kv cache telemetry).
commits: Add token-level Prometheus metrics and histogram buckets
Instrument KV cache for hits/misses and latency
Add tracing spans and baggage for request metadata
Enrich structured logs with token metrics and estimated cost
review_comments: Diego Martinez: Can we avoid high-cardinality labels on the token histogram? Suggest removing full customer ids and use customer_tier only.
Ava Chen (author): Switched transaction label to customer_tier and added a hashed_customer_id label only for sampled spans to preserve privacy and limit cardinality.
Priya Nair: Alerting thresholds look noisy for small customers; propose adding a minimum traffic filter before firing.
Ava Chen: Added min_hits_window filter to alert rules and a suppression rule for customers < 100 tokens/minute.
Luca Romano: Trace sampling looks high — reduced token-level span sampling to 0.1% in config and added centralized debug flag for on-demand higher sampling.
CI Bot: presubmit observability_checks failed on first run (missing export in metrics registry), author pushed fix in second commit.
Priya Nair: Approved after verifying dashboards and runbook steps in staging.
Diego Martinez: LGTM; merging with squash once CI green.
ci_summary: Initial presubmit failed due to metrics registry omission; fixed and all checks passed on rerun. CI checks: go-test (pass), lint (pass), e2e-smoke (pass), grafana-lint (pass), integration (pass).
merge_commit_message:
observability: token-level + KV cache metrics, dashboards, and alert tuning

Squash-merged from feature/observability/token-kv-metrics-dashboards. Adds token and KV metrics, tracing spans, structured logging enrichment, Grafana dashboards, alert tuning, docs and runbook.
release_notes: Adds token-level cost & latency metrics and KV cache telemetry. New dashboards and tuned alerts enable SREs and engineers to triage per-token regressions and optimize cache effectiveness. Opt-in behind observability.token_kv_enabled feature flag.
notes_for_ops: Feature is behind feature flag; rollout plan: enable in staging for 48h, validate metric cardinality dashboards, stagger enabling in production by customer-tier. Watch for increased prometheus ingestion and tracer storage during initial rollout.
testing: Unit tests for metric label validation added. E2E smoke test validates structured log enrichment. Manual dashboard validation performed on staging with synthetic workloads.
changelog_entry: 2026-02-24: Added token-level and KV cache observability (metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerts) behind feature flag.
security_considerations: Avoided PII in labels: customer_id replaced with customer_tier and hashed_customer_id only for sampled spans. Logs exclude raw prompts; only token counts and estimated cost emitted. Feature flag allows disabling collection if required by customer policy.
